observed_reality.prior_candidate_gap: The PR 460 runtime check inspected PRAGMA journal_mode only after sqlite3.connect(); existing migrations also connected before applying migration storage policy.
observed_reality.upstream_boundary: SQLite WAL documentation states that the first connection after a crash may participate in WAL recovery; the database header encodes file-format write/read versions at bytes 18 and 19, where 2 denotes WAL.
observed_reality.risk: On a vulnerable or unattested SQLite runtime, a post-connect gate can be too late to guarantee that unsafe WAL recovery was never entered.

grf.generated_reality: A post-connect PRAGMA gate is sufficient because it rejects WAL before Frank performs ordinary application reads or writes.
grf.counter_reality: sqlite3.connect itself can enter WAL recovery after a crash, so the safety boundary must discriminate persisted WAL before invoking vulnerable/unattested SQLite.
grf.discriminating_test: Create an existing WAL database, substitute a vulnerable semantic SQLite version, patch sqlite3.connect to raise if called, and require rejection from ordinary file-header inspection with connect call count exactly zero. Repeat for the existing-database migration path.

implemented_delta.mechanism: For vulnerable/unattested SQLite families, read and validate the first 20 database bytes with ordinary file I/O before sqlite3.connect; reject WAL header versions (2,2), reject unsupported/malformed formats, admit rollback header (1,1), and keep post-open storage verification as a second boundary. Existing migration databases receive the same preflight before any connection.
implemented_delta.rollback: Revert the four candidate commits on PR 460; no production installation or canonical state was mutated by this repair.

required_cases_added: vulnerable WAL open rejects before sqlite3.connect
vulnerable rollback-journal open remains admitted and FULL synchronous
unknown/mixed file-format versions fail before connect
existing vulnerable WAL migration rejects before sqlite3.connect

counterevidence_and_nonclaims.preflight_toctou_remaining: A path can in principle change between file-header preflight and sqlite3.connect; this patch does not prove hostile path-swap resistance or exact mapped-object identity.
counterevidence_and_nonclaims.fixed_runtime_identity_remaining: Semantic version-family classification is not artifact authority; accepted product runtime still requires provenance-bound exact loaded-object/source identity.
counterevidence_and_nonclaims.productive_parent_remaining: No claim that the productive Frank service/start parent non-bypassably installs or admits the accepted private SQLite runtime.

reentry.architecture_delta: Move the WAL safety boundary before any vulnerable/unattested SQLite connection, while retaining a second post-open verification boundary.
